## Editor guide

**3D:** right button + WASD/QE to fly; drag with the left button to move forward and turn; both buttons to move up/down. Alt + left orbits, Alt + right zooms, Alt + middle pans. F focuses. Right-click opens common actions.

**Scenes:** + Scene creates an empty layout, duplicates the current layout or chooses another location. NPCs, objects and events belong to each scene.

**Inventory:** select an NPC → Edit starting inventory → + From catalogue. Apply is undoable.
